verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores every note as non-proprietary plain-text Markdown in a local vault, and the docs say this lets you switch to another app easily and use other editors and file managers on your notes. You can also switch from Wikilinks to standard Markdown links for interoperability. Community users independently confirm they own their files and that the notes can outlive Obsidian. The only community concern is that Canvas uses JSON .canvas files rather than Markdown, which is a worry about format trends rather than evidence of lock-in. Missing for 10: documentation on how portable non-Markdown artifacts (Canvas JSON, Bases views) and Wikilink-style vaults are when moved to other apps.
